text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although neither Satono Diamond nor Kitasan Black take first, the audience is thrilled by their fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio are among those watching from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black both bite back their disappointment, feeling they can't let things finish as they are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black proposes a rematch at the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some discussion, Satono Diamond and I decide that she'll also enter the spring Tenno Sho.
